title: Directory Listing Extractor - Input
description: Configure directory/map extraction from embedded JS objects or DOM listings.

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: Extraction mode. Use embedded_js for JS-embedded listing objects. Use dom for HTML listing cards.

startUrls.title: Start URLs
startUrls.description: One or more directory/map pages to crawl.

maxListings.title: Max listings
maxListings.description: Safety cap for number of dataset items produced.

maxPages.title: Max pages
maxPages.description: Safety cap for number of pages visited.

debug.title: Debug logging
debug.description: Print verbose logs for troubleshooting (responses, taxonomy detection, counts).

outputCsv.title: Export CSV
outputCsv.description: Generate output.csv in the run output (in addition to dataset).

outputXlsx.title: Export XLSX
outputXlsx.description: Generate output.xlsx in the run output (in addition to dataset).

outputColumnsMode.title: Output columns mode
outputColumnsMode.description: default = core columns only, all = includes extra fields (address, quote, logo, etc.).

outputBaseName.title: Output base name
outputBaseName.description: Base name for exported files (without extension).

embedded.title: Embedded extraction
embedded.description: Controls extraction of embedded JSON/LD data and mapping to output fields.

enabled.title: Enable embedded extraction
enabled.description: If true, the Actor will try to extract embedded JSON/LD data (e.g., JSON-LD, script tags) and map it using fieldMap.

preferJsonLd.title: Prefer JSON-LD
preferJsonLd.description: If true, prefer schema.org JSON-LD blocks when multiple embedded formats are present.

fieldMap.title: Field map
fieldMap.description: Map raw embedded keys to your output field names. Keys are source keys, values are output fields.
